title: San Francisco Burrito Catalog

scope.description: San Francisco city limits; curated businesses with selected verified SF branches, plus a separate opening/reopening watchlist.

methodology: Curated research, not an exhaustive census or a firsthand tasting ranking. Shortlist is an editorial starting selection for variety.
California-style means fries or a comparable potato filling inside the burrito. Classic Mission identifies the local large burrito tradition; recipes vary.
Burrito-specific criticism, restaurant/taco coverage, historical reviews and menu-only candidates are labeled separately. Old reviews do not establish current quality.
Recommendations and vibes apply only to their location_ids. Additional branches are listed for discovery, without transferring a reviewed branch’s verdict.
Vibe source_summary paraphrases a source; format_inference is an interpretation of the venue format, not a firsthand observation. Unknown remains null.
Operating status listed means a source lists the venue, not a live confirmation that it is open. Watchlist entries are not current recommendations.
Hours are posted weekly schedules in America/Los_Angeles, not live availability. Null means unknown; [] means a source explicitly reports closed. Overnight windows belong to the day they open.
Restaurant, kitchen, online-ordering and truck schedules are distinguished. Holiday exceptions, outages and event changes are not modeled; consult the linked operator.
Checked_on is the research date, not a source publication date or a phone/in-person verification. Published_on is null when an exact publication date was not established.
Prefer current operator pages for addresses and hours; directories and ordering platforms are explicitly attributed when primary details are unavailable.
